title: Dutch Pepper Stew
description: A hearty stew made with tender chunks of beef, sweet red peppers, and a hint of Dutch mustard. Perfect for a cold winter's night.
instructions: Heat 2 tbsp of oil in a large pot over medium-high heat.
Add the beef and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the sliced red peppers and cook for an additional 3 minutes.
Stir in the diced tomatoes, ground pepper, and ground mustard.
Add the salt and pepper to taste.
Pour in the water and bring the mixture to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 1.5 hours.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
